text_blocks.snippet: Warning signs of a stroke can be remembered using the acronym BE FAST: Balance (sudden loss of balance), Eyes (sudden vision changes), Face (drooping), Arm (weakness), Speech (difficulty), and Time (call 911 immediately). These symptoms can be sudden and should be addressed immediately by calling emergency services.
